error_msg: Locator.wait_for: Unexpected token ! while parsing css selector
fix_applied: NEVER use placeholder text as a CSS selector. For Twitter tweet textarea use [data-testid="tweetTextarea_0"]. For Twitter DM input use [data-testid="dmComposerTextInput"]. Always use data-testid selectors from memory/knowledge/browser_session_selectors.md.

error_msg: type_text() got multiple values for argument 'target'
fix_applied: Call type_text with plain positional args: type_text('[data-testid="tweetTextarea_0"]', 'tweet text') — do NOT mix named kwarg target= with positional args in the same call.

error_msg: Agent calls list_tabs + goto then outputs 'All steps completed' without clicking compose or typing
fix_applied: NEVER require a screenshot to confirm page state before proceeding. Use get_text() instead. social_media_dm_guide.md General Rule #1 said 'Always screenshot first' which conflicted with SO#21 'never screenshot' — agent deadlocked and stopped. Always use get_text() for page state verification, never screenshot unless user explicitly requests it.

error_msg: Locator.wait_for: Error while parsing css selector '0'. Did you mean to CSS.escape it?
fix_applied: NEVER pass a bare number to click(). The first argument is a CSS selector, NOT a tab index. Tab index goes in the tab_index parameter. Wrong: click('0'). Correct: click('[data-testid="SideNav_NewTweet_Button"]', tab_index=0).

error_msg: Agent typed tweet text successfully but stopped without clicking the post button
fix_applied: Typing text into the compose box does NOT post the tweet. After clicking SideNav_NewTweet_Button the URL becomes x.com/compose/post — on that page use [data-testid="tweetButton"] (NOT tweetButtonInline). Full workflow: (1) goto x.com/home, (2) click '[data-testid="SideNav_NewTweet_Button"]', (3) type_text '[data-testid="tweetTextarea_0"]', (4) click '[data-testid="tweetButton"]'. Step 4 is MANDATORY.

error_msg: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'False'
fix_applied: Do NOT pass tab_index=False or clear_first as a string. Use only: type_text('[data-testid="tweetTextarea_0"]', 'tweet text') — omit optional args entirely unless needed. Never pass tab_index=False; use tab_index=0.

error_msg: Agent chains goto+click+type_text+click but stops early and never clicks the post button
fix_applied: Use browser_session.tweet('text') — a single function that handles the complete workflow internally. NEVER chain the 4 steps manually. tweet() is the ONLY correct way to post on Twitter.
